name: Daebom Stickers Addon
teaser: Stickers of artworks made by War Thunder Artist, Daebom
description_html:
Collection of Daebom’s artwork featuring his War Thunder OCs and other characters drawn by him.

I had made a similar addon before for ARC9 weapon mod on GMOD, so when the Weapon Camo and Sticker mod for SPT were released, I wanted to the same thing too here.

Disclaimer: Some stickers may have weird ratio or has lower resolution, this is because I took the VTF files from the addon I made before and use a tool to export them as PNGs. I will try to find the original versions of them in the near future.

Credit to Daebom for the artwork. If you, Daebom sir, wanted me to take this down then I will comply to your request immediately.
